name: AI Lead Generation Agent - Complete Lead Qualification & Outreach System

parameters.formDescription: Submit inbound lead details for automated AI qualification

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "model": "llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
  "temperature": 0.2,
  "response_format": { "type": "json_object" },
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "You are an intelligent AI Lead Qualification and Sales Support Agent.

Your job is to analyze each incoming lead, determine whether the lead is a good prospect, assign a lead score, explain the score, and prepare the lead for the next stage of the sales workflow.

Analyze the following information when available:
- Lead name
- Job title
- Company
- Industry
- Company size
- Location
- Website
- Business need or pain point
- Buying signals
- Source of the lead
- Available contact information

Follow these rules:
1. Determine whether the lead is Qualified or Not Qualified.
2. Score the lead from 0 to 100.
3. Consider:
 - Job/title relevance
 - Company fit
 - Industry fit
 - Potential business need
 - Buying intent or buying signals
 - Data completeness
4. Provide a short and clear reason for the qualification decision.
5. Do not invent missing company information, personal information, contact details, buying signals, or business facts.
6. If important information is missing, mark the relevant field as Unknown rather than guessing.
7. For qualified leads, create a concise personalization summary that can be used to write an outreach message.
8. Generate a professional outreach subject and message that are relevant to the available information. Do not make unsupported claims.
9. Do not send messages yourself. The workflow will handle the sending step after any required human approval.
10. If the lead is not qualified, recommend either Archive or Nurture.

Return the result in this structure:
{
 "lead_name": "",
 "company": "",
 "job_title": "",
 "qualification": "qualified or not_qualified",
 "lead_score": 0,
 "reason": "",
 "pain_point": "",
 "buying_signal": "",
 "personalization": "",
 "recommended_action": "outreach, nurture, or archive",
 "email_subject": "",
 "email_body": ""
}

Keep the output factual, concise, and suitable for downstream workflow automation."
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "Analyze this prospect:
Name: {{ $json.lead_name }}
Email: {{ $json.email }}
Phone: {{ $json.phone }}
Title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Industry: {{ $json.industry }}
Company Size: {{ $json.company_size }}
Location: {{ $json.location }}
Website: {{ $json.website }}
Pain Point: {{ $json.pain_point }}
Buying Signal: {{ $json.buying_signal }}
Source: {{ $json.source }}"
    }
  ]
}

nodes.name: Groq-Powered AI Lead Qualification Step (HTTP Request)
Human Approval Gateway (Wait for Form Decision)

conditions.leftValue: ={{ $json.approval_decision || $json['approval_decision'] || $json.approvalDecision || $json['Approval Decision'] || $('Human Approval Gateway (Wait for Form Decision)').item.json.approval_decision }}

assignments.name: rejection_note
assignments.value: ={{ $json.rejection_note || $('Human Approval Gateway (Wait for Form Decision)').item.json.rejection_note || 'Outreach draft rejected during human supervisory review. Halting outreach.' }}

assignments.name: outreach_channel
assignments.value: Email (Outreach prepared after human approval - Demo Safe Mode)

assignments.name: email_envelope
assignments.value: ={{ { to: ($json.email || $('Lead Enrichment & Scoring Verification').item.json.email), subject: ($json.email_subject || $('Lead Enrichment & Scoring Verification').item.json.email_subject), body: ($json.email_body || $('Lead Enrichment & Scoring Verification').item.json.email_body), reply_to: 'sales-agent@company.example.com' } }}

assignments.name: resolution
assignments.value: Prospect declined engagement. Record moved to quarterly nurture list.

assignments.name: sales_handoff_dossier
assignments.value:
={{ {
  handoff_id: 'HANDOFF-' + String(Date.now()).slice(-6),
  prospect_name: $json.lead_name,
  company: $json.company,
  title: $json.job_title,
  email: $json.email,
  phone: $json.phone,
  lead_score: $json.lead_score,
  qualification_summary: $json.qualification_reason,
  identified_pain_point: $json.pain_point,
  buying_signals: $json.buying_signal,
  prospect_sentiment: $json.response_sentiment,
  recommended_next_step: $json.recommended_sales_action,
  assigned_account_exec: 'Enterprise Sales Team A',
  handoff_priority: 'Urgent (Respond < 2 Hours)',
  created_at: new Date().toISOString()
} }}

main.node: Groq-Powered AI Lead Qualification Step (HTTP Request)
Human Approval Gateway (Wait for Form Decision)
